AW9 Games: Card Games, Slots & Flight Games

Browse the game types featured on the AW9 homepage. This guide explains the categories so you can find the relevant section in your chosen app.

Aviator Pro

A flight game with a multiplier that increases during a round. The round can end at any time; players must cash out before it ends. The timing of a previous round does not guarantee the next result.

Dragon Tiger

A card comparison game built around the Dragon and Tiger positions. Review the game's rules for card values, ties and available choices before joining a round.

7Up 7Down

A dice game based on whether a total falls above or below seven, with a separate seven outcome where offered. Check the in-app rules for payouts and round details.

3 Patti

A three-card game featuring ranked hands. Table rules and available play modes can differ, so review the hand rankings shown by the game.

Slots

Slot games use themed reels and symbol combinations. Each game's paytable describes its winning combinations, bonus features and limits.

Fishing games

The homepage also features Fishing King. Open the game's own instructions for its controls, scoring and available features.

Finding a game

Choose an app from the download page, then use its game menu. Availability and rules depend on the selected platform. Promotion conditions are covered separately in the rewards guide.
